I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened a SEV2 incident (INC-0001), which paged the on-call engineer.

- **What was wrong:** The latest release, v2.3.1, was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also failed in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that had been healthy in production. After the rollback, all three regions are running v2.3.0 and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure and the rollback, and asks for the cause of the v2.3.1 failure to be found before it's deployed again.
  - The first attempt to open it timed out. I checked the incident list, confirmed nothing had been created, then retried with the same idempotency key, so there's only one incident.
